stick.gimbal.name: Stick (roll / pitch)
stick.gimbal.note: on the inset: base of the Suncom SFS stick

throttle.axis.name: throttle.axis
throttle.axis.note: on the inset: the Suncom SFS F-15 throttle handle (left/right throttle axes)

unplaced.throttle.ministick: virtual cursor axes generated by the adapter, no physical control
unplaced.throttle.axis.rotary.1: virtual antenna axis generated by the adapter, no physical control
unplaced.throttle.axis.rotary.2: virtual range axis generated by the adapter, no physical control

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), the FUSBA adapter board, with an inset (bottom right) of the Suncom SFS F-15 throttle and SFS stick it connects
mappingSource: FUSBA User Guide v1.04 (https://www.realsimulator.com/download/FUSBA_User_Guide.pdf) p.20: throttle left/right axes, stick X/Y, 4 virtual axes (cursor X/Y, antenna, range); numbers only in the configuration tool (catalog gives no inputs)
note: The adapter itself has no controls; the stick and throttle markers are on the small inset picture of the Suncom hardware (about 15% of the photo). Cursor, antenna and range are virtual axes generated by the adapter, not physical controls, so they are not placed.
